headline: Indian Markets Mixed As Sensex Dips On IT And Tata Weakness
why: Sensex and Nifty face pressure, extending a six-week consecutive falling trend.
Weakness in IT stocks and Tata Group shares weighed down the Sensex.
Investors are cautious over US Fed rate hikes and a potential AI slowdown.
Easing crude oil prices and RBI intervention helped stabilize the Rupee.
whatHappening: Indian benchmarks closed mixed with Nifty showing resilience while Sensex posted minor losses.
The Rupee halted its losing streak thanks to direct support from the RBI.
Gold prices rebounded to a one-week high following a retreat in crude oil.
Paytm and major IT stocks dominated investor attention during the trading session.

summary:
Indian equity markets delivered a mixed performance as the Sensex dipped on IT and Tata stock weakness, while Nifty held gains.
Macroeconomic factors such as RBI intervention and falling crude oil prices helped the Rupee break its recent losing streak.
Global triggers, including US Fed rate expectations and AI growth concerns, continue to keep market participants cautious.
